pictures.name: SV1-Dawn-River
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Dawn mist over a quiet tree-lined river in old Punjab, the river Vein near Sultanpur. Guru Nanak is seen only from behind, his face never visible: a tall figure in a long faded saffron-brown robe, a simple wrapped turban, a cloth bag on his shoulder, wading slowly into the still, shallow water, seen only from behind and at a distance. His folded clothes and a water pot rest on the grassy bank. Soft pink-gold sunrise, deep blue mist, peaceful.

pictures.name: SV2-Searching-Banks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The same misty riverbank by day. Worried townspeople of old Punjab, men in turbans and women in head-coverings, walk the reeds and shallows, a few in a small wooden boat with poles, calling and searching gently. A folded saffron-brown robe and a water pot lie on the bank. Grey-blue light, quiet concern, no danger.

pictures.name: SV3-Out-Of-The-Water
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The third morning. Guru Nanak is seen only from behind, his face never visible: a tall figure in a long faded saffron-brown robe, a simple wrapped turban, a cloth bag on his shoulder, standing on the riverbank having just come out of the water, seen only from behind, glowing in a shaft of gold sunrise light.
